$comment: The reference run of the clean control. The epic's genuine risk set is small and this run reports two
risks, under the ceiling of three, and reaches none of the four risks the epic rules out.
The document is CONSTRUCTED. Its two risks are the ones the epic actually leaves open: a drifted device
clock making a relative time read as recent, and the absent-value case having to hide the row.
derivation: Two risk rows, R-001 and R-002, so wellFormedIds is 2 and validCategories is 2 over BUS and TECH.
Scale and arithmetic: 2x2=4 and 2x1=2. Both factors in range on both rows, so inScale is 2, the
arithmetic denominator is 2 and arithmeticOk is 2.
Bands: 4 under Score 3-4 and 2 under Score 1-2, so banded is 2 and bandOk is 2.
Risk links: two coverage rows, each naming a declared id, so 2 of 2 resolve.
The clean set declares no material risk, so grounding is 0 of 0, coverage evaluates nothing and no
ordering pair exists. None of the four ruled-out matchers fires on either description, so ungrounded
is empty.
Clean control: two rows against a ceiling of three, so the excess is 0.
WHAT MOVED AT SCORER VERSION 5
`banded` is now `rows` on every case, because a row under a heading that declares no score range is a
band failure rather than an exemption. `cleanControl` is `ceiling` and both sets declare one, so the
seeded corpus is bounded too. `grounding` carries `topSeverityMissed`, the count of the set's
lowest-ranked risks that went unreported. Material risks are assigned by maximum matching rather than
first-come, and every row is tested against the exclusions whether or not it matched a material risk.
AT SCORER VERSION 6
`ordering` carries `flattened`, which is true when every material risk that reached a priority reached
the same one. A plan like that satisfies every pairwise constraint without ordering anything, so the
metric reports unmeasurable rather than a perfect score.
AT SCORER VERSION 7
`unscoredRiskTables` records every table that names risks with an `R-NNN` id and states no score. Such a
table cannot be scored and used to be skipped without a word, so a register split across a scored table
and an unscored one lost its second half silently. The threshold on the count is zero.
